extension.description: Local VS Code helpers for Pandoc Markdown labels, cross references, math hovers, and outline symbols.
command.buildDocxAndOpen: Papper Tools: Build DOCX and Open in Word
command.installOrUpdatePapper: Papper Tools: Install or Update Papper
command.openImagePreviewToSide: Papper Tools: Open Image Preview to the Side
command.openSvgSourceText: Papper Tools: Reopen SVG as Source Text
configuration.enableDiagnostics: Report undefined Pandoc cross references and duplicate labels in open Markdown documents.
configuration.enableNumberInlayHints: Show section, equation, figure, and table numbers plus actual bibliography and cross-reference text from Papper's processed Pandoc AST in Markdown inlay hints.
configuration.includeWorkspaceReferences: Preload Markdown files in the current workspace for the index cache. Lookups remain scoped to the active document except that reply_to_reviewers.md also uses definitions from the workspace-root manuscript.md.
configuration.includeLabelSymbols: Add equation, figure, and table labels as nested outline symbols below their nearest heading.
configuration.highlightFencedDivs: Highlight Pandoc fenced div blocks with subtle whole-line background colors.
configuration.highlightBracketedSpans: Highlight Pandoc bracketed spans with subtle inline background colors.
configuration.foldLineExcerptCodeSpans: Fold the backtick-delimited excerpt in Markdown annotations such as (Line `quoted text`) until the cursor enters it.
configuration.foldRevisionCharSpanAttrib: Fold the attribute block in Pandoc spans whose custom-style value is exactly Revision Char until the cursor enters it.
configuration.enableInlineMathParagraphH: Show a paragraph-level hover preview when hovering over a Markdown paragraph that contains inline math.
configuration.inlineMathParagraphHoverMa: Maximum paragraph length, in characters, that can show an inline-math paragraph hover preview.
configuration.enableParagraphHoverTransl: Show translations for eligible English Markdown paragraphs and nearby code comments, using Google Translate when available and Microsoft Translator as a fallback.
configuration.debugParagraphHoverTransla: Log complete paragraph translation requests and responses for debugging. Disabled by default to keep output concise.
configuration.enableDiffAwareParagraphHo: When VS Code exposes diff information, mark added or removed sentences in paragraph translation hovers with the editor's diff colors.
configuration.paragraphHoverTranslationM: Maximum English paragraph length, in characters, that can request a paragraph hover translation.
configuration.paragraphHoverTranslationT: Target language code for paragraph hover translations, for example zh or zh-TW.
configuration.imageDirectoryPreviewScanD: Maximum subfolder depth scanned by Image Directory Preview. Use -1 for unlimited recursion, 0 for only the selected folder, or a positive integer for that many subfolder levels.
configuration.imageDirectoryPreviewInclu: Only include images whose root-relative folder path contains one of these case-insensitive keywords. Leave empty to include all folders not excluded.
configuration.imageDirectoryPreviewExclu: Skip folders whose root-relative path contains one of these case-insensitive keywords. Exclusion takes precedence over inclusion.
